mamba-ssm 2.3.1+pt2.11.0cu128sm80to120ptx100 - statement of changes

This wheel is built from mamba (https://github.com/state-spaces/mamba, Apache License 2.0) at tag
v2.3.1. The file below was modified by NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, 2026.

Changes applied by the NuRec build:
- setup.py: lines 175-204, the hard-coded -gencode list of CUDA architectures, removed so the
  architectures come from the build environment.
The local version comes from MAMBA_LOCAL_VERSION at build time.
